main_text.p: dibus vestris. Ephes.3.16.17. Item, Sed veritatem sectantes cum charitate, prorsus adolescamus in eum per omnia, qui est caput, nempe Christus. Cap.4.15.

Deinde verò, vt cum omnibus Sanctis colamus pacem, quandoquidem membra sumus vnius mystici corporis, in quo nulla seditio, nullum schisma esse debet. Iuxta illud: Ex quo Christo, totum corpus congruenter, coagmentatum, & compactum per omnes suppeditatas commissuras, ex vi in tus agente pro mensura vniuscuiusq; me-bri, incrementum capit corpori coueniēs, ad suiipsius exstructionem per charitatem. Eph.4.16. Item, Adhæc omnia induimini charitate, quæ est vinculum perfectionis. Col.3.14.

Postremò, non parum conducunt ad spe quæ verè sacra anchora est, in nobis confirmādam. Quemadmodum enim olim san-cti homines, Prophetarum prædictionibus de confociatione fidelium Israelitarum, Iudæorum & gentium, velut dolorum, quos pariebant dissidia de religione & eorum tristia effecta, remedijs, vti[?] sunt: ita nos postquam oraculis illis euentus respondisse, ita nobis constat, hac eadem spe dolores nostros leniamus, persuasum habentes in Domino

page.notes: Line-end hyphen in "fan/ēti" is printed as a slash-like mark; read as "san-cti", with the initial letter and mark uncertain. "vfi" is unclear; read as "vti[?]". The last word "mino" stands at the right below the final full line and is the second half of "Domino" (broken at the line end, no printed hyphen), so it is not a catchword. Page number "ııʃ" is read as 117 with uncertainty. Stain or mark at the lower centre is not transcribed.
